description: Curvature-based primitives defining drift, load, synthetic pressure, collapse thresholds, recovery attractors, and lawful manifold transitions across DSLO substrates.

drift.definition: Directional curvature displacement over time within a lawful manifold.

load.definition: Accumulated curvature stress applied to a substrate surface.

synthetic_pressure.definition: Externally induced curvature forcing that modifies drift or load behavior.

collapse_threshold.definition: Critical curvature boundary beyond which lawful manifold behavior fails.

recovery_attractor.definition: Curvature basin that restores lawful manifold behavior after collapse.

manifold_transition.definition: Lawful movement between manifold states governed by curvature constraints.

notes.lawfulness: All primitives obey DSLO legality invariants and cross-surface consistency.
notes.cross_domain: Primitives apply uniformly across biological, cultural, abstract, physical, and machine-facing substrates.
notes.integration: Geometry primitives bind directly to surfaces, invariants, and examples within the v0.7 release cluster.
